\section[(dialogue)]{School, nature, animals and describing words — a first pass}

\label{lesson:BN-R89-first-pass-school-nature-animals-and-describing-wor}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a story and a toy.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a mountain, a forest, a river, a pond, a stone
  \item sand, the moon, the sea, fire, ice
  \item soil, wind, the sky, a dog, a cat
  \item a cow, a goat, a sheep, a bird, a mouse
  \item a lion, an elephant, a monkey, a snake, a crow
  \item a bear, a donkey, a butterfly, an ant, a hen
  \item big, small, new, old, bad
  \item long, hot, slowly, quickly, easy
  \item expensive, cheap, low, full, empty
  \item rich, poor, dirty, bitter, sour
  \item fat, thin, light, heavy, true
  \item false, yellow, brown, beautiful, a day
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A mountain? (\textbf{\bn{পাহাড়}}, \emph{pāhāṛ}.) A forest? (\textbf{\bn{বন}}, \emph{bôn}.) A river? (\textbf{\bn{নদী}}, \emph{nôdi}.) A pond? (\textbf{\bn{পুকুর}}, \emph{pukur}.) A stone? (\textbf{\bn{পাথর}}, \emph{pāthôr}.) Sand? (\textbf{\bn{বালি}}, \emph{bāli}.) The moon? (\textbf{\bn{চাঁদ}}, \emph{chā̃d}.) The sea? (\textbf{\bn{সমুদ্র}}, \emph{sômudrô}.) Fire? (\textbf{\bn{আগুন}}, \emph{āgun}.) Ice? (\textbf{\bn{বরফ}}, \emph{bôrôph}.) Soil? (\textbf{\bn{মাটি}}, \emph{māṭi}.) Wind? (\textbf{\bn{বাতাস}}, \emph{bātās}.) The sky? (\textbf{\bn{আকাশ}}, \emph{ākāsh}.) A dog? (\textbf{\bn{কুকুর}}, \emph{kukur}.) A cat? (\textbf{\bn{বিড়াল}}, \emph{biṛāl}.) A cow? (\textbf{\bn{গরু}}, \emph{gôru}.) A goat? (\textbf{\bn{ছাগল}}, \emph{chhāgôl}.) A sheep? (\textbf{\bn{ভেড়া}}, \emph{bheṛā}.) A bird? (\textbf{\bn{পাখি}}, \emph{pākhi}.) A mouse? (\textbf{\bn{ইঁদুর}}, \emph{ĩdur}.) A lion? (\textbf{\bn{সিংহ}}, \emph{singhô}.) An elephant? (\textbf{\bn{হাতি}}, \emph{hāti}.) A monkey? (\textbf{\bn{বানর}}, \emph{bānôr}.) A snake? (\textbf{\bn{সাপ}}, \emph{sāp}.) A crow? (\textbf{\bn{কাক}}, \emph{kāk}.) A bear? (\textbf{\bn{ভালুক}}, \emph{bhāluk}.) A donkey? (\textbf{\bn{গাধা}}, \emph{gādhā}.) A butterfly? (\textbf{\bn{প্রজাপতি}}, \emph{prôjāpôti}.) An ant? (\textbf{\bn{পিঁপড়ে}}, \emph{pĩpṛe}.) A hen? (\textbf{\bn{মুরগি}}, \emph{murgi}.) Big? (\textbf{\bn{বড়}}, \emph{bôṛo}.) Small? (\textbf{\bn{ছোট}}, \emph{chhoṭo}.) New? (\textbf{\bn{নতুন}}, \emph{nôtun}.) Old? (\textbf{\bn{পুরনো}}, \emph{purôno}.) Bad? (\textbf{\bn{খারাপ}}, \emph{khārāp}.) Long? (\textbf{\bn{লম্বা}}, \emph{lômbā}.) Hot? (\textbf{\bn{গরম}}, \emph{gôrôm}.) Slowly? (\textbf{\bn{আস্তে}}, \emph{āste}.) Quickly? (\textbf{\bn{তাড়াতাড়ি}}, \emph{tāṛātāṛi}.) Easy? (\textbf{\bn{সহজ}}, \emph{sôhôj}.) Expensive? (\textbf{\bn{দামি}}, \emph{dāmi}.) Cheap? (\textbf{\bn{সস্তা}}, \emph{sôstā}.) Low? (\textbf{\bn{নিচু}}, \emph{nichu}.) Full? (\textbf{\bn{ভর্তি}}, \emph{bhôrti}.) Empty? (\textbf{\bn{খালি}}, \emph{khāli}.) Rich? (\textbf{\bn{ধনী}}, \emph{dhôni}.) Poor? (\textbf{\bn{গরিব}}, \emph{gôrib}.) Dirty? (\textbf{\bn{নোংরা}}, \emph{nongrā}.) Bitter? (\textbf{\bn{তেতো}}, \emph{teto}.) Sour? (\textbf{\bn{টক}}, \emph{ṭôk}.) Fat? (\textbf{\bn{মোটা}}, \emph{moṭā}.) Thin? (\textbf{\bn{রোগা}}, \emph{rogā}.) Light? (\textbf{\bn{হালকা}}, \emph{hālkā}.) Heavy? (\textbf{\bn{ভারী}}, \emph{bhāri}.) True? (\textbf{\bn{সত্যি}}, \emph{sôtti}.) False? (\textbf{\bn{মিথ্যা}}, \emph{mitthā}.) Yellow? (\textbf{\bn{হলুদ}}, \emph{hôlud}.) Brown? (\textbf{\bn{বাদামি}}, \emph{bādāmi}.) Beautiful? (\textbf{\bn{সুন্দর}}, \emph{sundôr}.) A day? (\textbf{\bn{দিন}}, \emph{din}.)

\section[(dialogue)]{Time, places, the town, clothes and numbers — a second pass}

\label{lesson:BN-R89-second-pass-time-places-the-town-clothes-and-numbers}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for night and evening.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item night, evening, morning, a week, a month
  \item a year, a minute, today, now, always
  \item lateness; late, before, after, time, midday
  \item near, inside, outside, below, in front
  \item behind, a shop, a road, a lane, a station
  \item a car, a bus, a bridge, a temple, a hotel
  \item the police, a bicycle, a market, a village, a city
  \item trousers, a sock, a pocket, a ring, a cap
  \item a shoe, six, seven, eight, ten
  \item twenty, thirty, forty, fifty, a hundred
  \item a thousand, the world, a colour, a song, a holiday
  \item music, news, a country, a story, a toy
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Night? (\textbf{\bn{রাত}}, \emph{rāt}.) Evening? (\textbf{\bn{সন্ধ্যা}}, \emph{sôndhyā}.) Morning? (\textbf{\bn{সকাল}}, \emph{sôkāl}.) A week? (\textbf{\bn{সপ্তাহ}}, \emph{sôptāhô}.) A month? (\textbf{\bn{মাস}}, \emph{māsh}.) A year? (\textbf{\bn{বছর}}, \emph{bôchhôr}.) A minute? (\textbf{\bn{মিনিট}}, \emph{miniṭ}.) Today? (\textbf{\bn{আজ}}, \emph{āj}.) Now? (\textbf{\bn{এখন}}, \emph{ekhôn}.) Always? (\textbf{\bn{সবসময়}}, \emph{sôbsômôy}.) Lateness; late? (\textbf{\bn{দেরি}}, \emph{deri}.) Before? (\textbf{\bn{আগে}}, \emph{āge}.) After? (\textbf{\bn{পরে}}, \emph{pôre}.) Time? (\textbf{\bn{সময়}}, \emph{sômôy}.) Midday? (\textbf{\bn{দুপুর}}, \emph{dupur}.) Near? (\textbf{\bn{কাছে}}, \emph{kāchhe}.) Inside? (\textbf{\bn{ভিতরে}}, \emph{bhitôre}.) Outside? (\textbf{\bn{বাইরে}}, \emph{bāire}.) Below? (\textbf{\bn{নিচে}}, \emph{niche}.) In front? (\textbf{\bn{সামনে}}, \emph{sāmne}.) Behind? (\textbf{\bn{পিছনে}}, \emph{pichhône}.) A shop? (\textbf{\bn{দোকান}}, \emph{dokān}.) A road? (\textbf{\bn{রাস্তা}}, \emph{rāstā}.) A lane? (\textbf{\bn{গলি}}, \emph{gôli}.) A station? (\textbf{\bn{স্টেশন}}, \emph{sṭeshôn}.) A car? (\textbf{\bn{গাড়ি}}, \emph{gāṛi}.) A bus? (\textbf{\bn{বাস}}, \emph{bās}.) A bridge? (\textbf{\bn{সেতু}}, \emph{setu}.) A temple? (\textbf{\bn{মন্দির}}, \emph{mondir}.) A hotel? (\textbf{\bn{হোটেল}}, \emph{hoṭel}.) The police? (\textbf{\bn{পুলিশ}}, \emph{pulish}.) A bicycle? (\textbf{\bn{সাইকেল}}, \emph{sāikel}.) A market? (\textbf{\bn{বাজার}}, \emph{bājār}.) A village? (\textbf{\bn{গ্রাম}}, \emph{grām}.) A city? (\textbf{\bn{শহর}}, \emph{shôhôr}.) Trousers? (\textbf{\bn{প্যান্ট}}, \emph{pænṭ}.) A sock? (\textbf{\bn{কুড়ি}}, \emph{kuṛi}.) Thirty? (\textbf{\bn{তিরিশ}}, \emph{tirish}.) Forty? (\textbf{\bn{চল্লিশ}}, \emph{chôllish}.) Fifty? (\textbf{\bn{পঞ্চাশ}}, \emph{pônchāsh}.) A hundred? (\textbf{\bn{একশো}}, \emph{ekshô}.) A thousand? (\textbf{\bn{হাজার}}, \emph{hājār}.) The world? (\textbf{\bn{পৃথিবী}}, \emph{prithibi}.) A colour? (\textbf{\bn{রং}}, \emph{rông}.) A song?
